title: Two Broker Apps
intro: Two apps offer to help you invest. One is Capitol Brokerage, a real, registered firm.
The other is Mirage with a stock ticker on his tie. Compare them side by side.

notify.text: Invest in shares: two different apps

decide_q: Which app is the registered broker, and what will you do?

screen.context: Both apps say they let you buy shares. You found one in the official store and one in a group.

v.text: Registration number shown, listed on the regulator's site
"Investing carries risk. Past results do not guarantee the future."
Your own bank account to the broker's regulated account
To your own bank account, any time

note.text: Support: office address and a published phone number.

v.text: A link in a group chat

src_b.label: Found in a group link
src_b.why: Install investing apps from the official store.

reg_b.label: No registration
reg_b.why: Deal only with registered firms, and check on the regulator's site.

pay_b.label: A personal account
pay_b.lens: Your money goes to a person, not a firm.
pay_b.why: A real broker takes money into regulated accounts.

wd_b.label: A "tax" to withdraw
wd_b.lens: You must pay first to take your own money out.
wd_b.why: Paying to withdraw is the scam.

note_b.label: Chat only support
note_b.why: Real firms tell you where they are.

src_a.label: Official app store
src_a.lens: Found in the phone's official store.
src_a.why: A good sign, but check more.

reg_a.label: Registration shown
reg_a.lens: A registration number you can check on the regulator's site.

promise_a.label: A risk warning
promise_a.lens: It warns that investing carries risk.

pay_a.label: Your own regulated account
pay_a.lens: Money goes to a regulated account.
pay_a.why: This is how real brokers work.

wd_a.label: Withdraw any time to your bank

note_a.label: Real contact details
note_a.lens: An office and a phone number.

actions.label: Not sure. Check each firm on the regulator's site
A is the broker. Report B

trap.title: Solis Shares App · Deposit
trap.ask: Deposit ₹50,000 to the account of our manager.

block_report.line: You picked the registered broker and reported the fake. The fake app was removed.

verify.line: The regulator's site listed App A and not App B. Case cracked.

pick_b.line: The ₹50,000 went to a stranger. The app showed a fake profit, then locked you out.

what_if.pick_b: App B had five warnings: a group link, no registration, a guarantee, a personal account and a withdrawal tax.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting B as well helps get it removed.

golden_rule: Check that a broker is registered on the regulator's own site. A fake app has no registration, guarantees profit and takes money into a personal account.

quick_check.q: Two apps. One guarantees 40% a month and takes money into a personal account. Which is the fake?

options.text: The one with a risk warning
The one that guarantees profit and uses a personal account

quick_check.explain: A guarantee and a personal account are the giveaways.

hints.nudge: Which app guarantees profit and wants money in a personal account?
